fields.title: ARMP Madagascar tender record
fields.description: One record per row. Shape depends on recordType: TENDER_AVIS (listType=avis, a live call for tender), TENDER_DOSSIER (listType=dossiers, an archived procurement dossier), or TENDER_CONTRAT (listType=contrats, an awarded contract -- raw passthrough of upstream's own field names/casing). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a page/query fails or is unreachable.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: Which list this record came from: 'list:avis', 'list:dossiers', or 'list:contrats'.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-index-by-region, S1-dossier-archive-search, S1-contrat-action-json, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

region.title: Region
region.description: TENDER_AVIS only -- one of Madagascar's administrative regions, e.g. 'CENTRALE', 'ANALAMANGA'.

entite.title: Procuring entity
entite.description: TENDER_AVIS only -- the government body running this procurement.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: TENDER_AVIS / TENDER_DOSSIER -- the procuring entity's own tender reference number.

modePassation.title: Procurement mode (code)
modePassation.description: TENDER_AVIS only -- short procurement-mode code, e.g. 'ACO', 'CPX'.

numero.title: Dossier number
numero.description: TENDER_AVIS / TENDER_DOSSIER -- ARMP's internal dossier number, e.g. '2600188-3CPX001'.

objet.title: Objet (title)
objet.description: TENDER_AVIS / TENDER_DOSSIER -- what is being procured.

dateDu.title: Open date
dateDu.description: TENDER_AVIS only -- bid submission opening date (YYYY-MM-DD).

noticePdfUrl.title: Notice PDF URL
noticePdfUrl.description: TENDER_AVIS only -- link to the official 'avis' notice document (ASAPC PDF).

institution.title: Institution
institution.description: TENDER_DOSSIER only -- the procuring government body.

modePassationLabel.title: Procurement mode (label)
modePassationLabel.description: TENDER_DOSSIER only -- full French procurement-mode label, e.g. 'Consultation de Prix par voie d`affichage'.

dateDossier.title: Dossier date
dateDossier.description: TENDER_DOSSIER only -- the dossier's own registration date (dd/mm/yyyy), from its detail view.

financement.title: Financing source
financement.description: TENDER_DOSSIER only -- e.g. 'RPI' (Ressources Propres Internes/domestic budget), from the dossier's detail view.

prmpNom.title: PRMP officer name
prmpNom.description: TENDER_DOSSIER / TENDER_CONTRAT (as PRMP_NOM) -- name of the Personne Responsable des Marches Publics (procurement officer) overseeing this dossier/contract.

ENTITE_LIBELLE.title: Entity name
ENTITE_LIBELLE.description: TENDER_CONTRAT only -- name of the procuring government body.

MODE_PASS_LIBELLE.title: Procurement mode
MODE_PASS_LIBELLE.description: TENDER_CONTRAT only -- e.g. 'APPEL D'OFFRE OUVERT INTERNATIONAL'.

CONTRAT_CODE.title: Contract number
CONTRAT_CODE.description: TENDER_CONTRAT only -- ARMP's internal contract number.

MTT_TTC.title: Contract amount
MTT_TTC.description: TENDER_CONTRAT only -- total contract amount (tax included), raw text as returned upstream, e.g. '848113200.00'.

TITULAIRE_NIF.title: Supplier tax ID (NIF)
TITULAIRE_NIF.description: TENDER_CONTRAT only -- the winning supplier's Malagasy tax identification number.

TITULAIRE_NOM.title: Supplier name
TITULAIRE_NOM.description: TENDER_CONTRAT only -- the winning bidder's name.

BENEFICIAIRE_EFFECTIF.title: Declared beneficial owner(s)
BENEFICIAIRE_EFFECTIF.description: TENDER_CONTRAT only -- the supplier's declared beneficial owner(s), semicolon-separated when more than one.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across all record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
